info.description:
HTTP relay proxy with fingerprinting and routing capabilities.
This API allows clients to proxy HTTP requests through distributed endpoints.
info.title: Straw Proxy Relay Server API

get.description: Returns paginated list of all API keys (without raw key values)

post.description: Creates a new API key. The raw key is returned only once in the response.

201.description: Created API key with raw key

delete.description: Revokes an API key by ID, preventing further use

get.description: Returns estimated billing cost for the specified time range

parameters.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD, default: start of month)
parameters.name: start

post.description: Clears Redis cache keys matching the specified pattern

get.description: Returns Redis server information and memory statistics
Returns all registered proxy endpoints with their health status

post.description: Marks an endpoint as draining, preventing new requests from being routed to it

get.description: Returns all available fingerprint presets for TLS fingerprinting

post.description: Creates a new fingerprint preset or updates an existing one
Sends all fingerprint presets to all connected endpoints via message broker

get.description: Returns OK if the server is running
Returns OK if the server is ready to accept traffic
Returns paginated list of all routing rules

post.description: Creates a new routing rule for request matching

get.description: Returns a specific routing rule by ID

put.description: Updates an existing routing rule by ID

delete.description: Deletes a routing rule by ID

get.description: Returns daily usage summaries for the specified time range

post.description:
Proxies an HTTP request through a matched endpoint based on routing rules.
The request is validated, filtered, rate-limited, and executed through the endpoint pool.

403.description: Request blocked by filter or scope

403.description: Request blocked by filter or scope

strategy.description:
Strategy determines how variants are selected.
Valid values: "random", "round_robin", "weighted"

variants.description: Variants are the different fingerprint options to test.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint is the TLS fingerprint preset ID.

weight.description: Weight is the percentage weight for weighted selection (0-100).

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the key was created.

expires_at.description: ExpiresAt is when the key expires (optional).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier for this API key.

is_active.description: IsActive indicates whether this key is currently active.

name.description: Name is a human-readable name for the key.

rate_limit_override.description:
RateLimitOverride allows per-key rate limit customization.
If set, overrides the routing rule's rate limit.

scopes.description:
Scopes define which tag patterns this key can access.
Supports wildcards, e.g., ["target:*", "type:search"]

token_hash.description:
TokenHash is the SHA256 hash of the Bearer token.
The actual token is only shown once during creation.

endpoints.description: Endpoints are endpoint IDs or tag selectors for this pool.

max_retries.description: MaxRetries is the maximum retry attempts within this pool before escalating.

tier.description: Tier is the priority of this pool (1 = Primary, 2 = Secondary, etc.).

config.description:
Config is the detailed configuration of the fingerprint.
This mirrors the structure expected by the fingerprinting engine.

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the preset was created.

id.description: ID is the unique identifier for this preset (e.g., "chrome-130").

name.description: Name is a human-readable name for the preset.

updated_at.description: UpdatedAt is when the preset was last modified.

adblock_lists.description:
AdblockLists specifies which blocklists to use.
Example: ["easylist", "easyprivacy"]

block_content_types.description:
BlockContentTypes blocks responses by Content-Type.
Example: ["image/*", "font/*", "video/*"]

block_domains.description: BlockDomains blocks requests to specific domains.

block_url_patterns.description:
BlockURLPatterns blocks requests matching URL patterns (glob/regex).
Example: ["*.google-analytics.com", "*/ads/*"]

allow_insecure_tls.description: AllowInsecureTLS allows skipping TLS certificate verification for targets.

allowed_endpoint_types.description:
AllowedEndpointTypes specifies which endpoint types can handle these requests.
Example: ["residential", "mobile"]

created_at.description: CreatedAt is when the rule was created.

endpoint_pools.description: EndpointPools defines tiered endpoint fallback pools.

excluded_tags.description: ExcludedTags are tags that a request must NOT have to match this rule (NOT logic).

fingerprint_ab_test.description: FingerprintABTest allows A/B testing different fingerprints.

fingerprint_preset.description:
FingerprintPreset specifies the default browser TLS fingerprint to use.
Example: "chrome-130"

hard_timeout.description: HardTimeout is the maximum time allowed for a request to complete.

id.description: ID is the unique identifier for this rule.

is_active.description: IsActive indicates whether this rule is currently active.

name.description: Name is a human-readable name for the rule.

priority.description: Priority determines rule precedence. Higher priority rules are evaluated first.

quota_key.description: QuotaKey is the key used for rate limit bucketing (e.g., "target:amazon").

rate_limit_per_minute.description: RateLimitPerMinute is the maximum requests per minute for this rule's quota key.

rate_limit_per_second.description: RateLimitPerSecond is the maximum requests per second for this rule's quota key.

required_endpoint_caps.description:
RequiredEndpointCaps are capability tags that endpoints must have.
Example: ["capability:stealth"]

required_tags.description: RequiredTags are the tags that a request MUST have to match this rule (AND logic).

updated_at.description: UpdatedAt is when the rule was last modified.

version.description: Version for optimistic locking on updates.

code.description: Code is a machine-readable error code (e.g., "UPSTREAM_ERROR").

message.description: Message is a human-readable error description.

retry_after.description: RetryAfter suggests how long to wait before retrying (optional).

retryable.description: Retryable indicates whether the client should retry the request.

body.description: Body contains the request body (for POST, PUT, etc.).

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint specifies which browser TLS fingerprint preset to use.

headers.description: Headers contains the HTTP headers to send.

id.description: ID is a unique identifier for this request (used for correlation).

method.description: Method is the HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.).

reply_to.description:
ReplyTo specifies the queue name to send the response to.
If empty, the endpoint generates a default result queue name.

session_id.description: SessionID links this request to a sticky session (optional).

timeout.description: Timeout specifies how long the Endpoint should wait for a response.

url.description: URL is the target URL to fetch.

endpoint_id.description: EndpointID identifies which endpoint handled this request.

error.description: Error contains error details if the request failed.

headers.description: Headers contains the HTTP response headers.

request_id.description: RequestID correlates this response to the original request.

session_id.description: SessionID if a session was created or used.

status_code.description: StatusCode is the HTTP status code received from the target.

timing.description: Timing contains request timing details for observability.

dns_lookup.description: DNSLookup is the time spent resolving DNS.

first_byte.description: FirstByte is the time until the first response byte was received.

tcp_connect.description: TCPConnect is the time spent establishing TCP connection.

tls_handshake.description: TLSHandshake is the time spent on TLS negotiation.

total.description: Total is the total request duration.

expires_at.description: ExpiresAt is when the key expires (optional).

id.description: ID is the unique identifier for this API key.

is_active.description: IsActive indicates whether this key is currently active.

name.description: Name is a human-readable name for the key.
